mapper.sql: FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_menu p1 ON p1.id = m.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu p2 ON p2.id = p1.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu p3 ON p3.id = p2.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu p4 ON p4.id = p3.parent_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND m.type = 'PAGE' AND m.enabled = TRUE AND (p1.id IS NULL OR (p1.type = 'DIRECTORY' AND p1.enabled = TRUE)) AND (p2.id IS NULL OR (p2.type = 'DIRECTORY' AND p2.enabled = TRUE)) AND (p3.id IS NULL OR (p3.type = 'DIRECTORY' AND p3.enabled = TRUE)) AND (p4.id IS NULL OR (p4.type = 'DIRECTORY' AND p4.enabled = TRUE)) AND p4.parent_id IS NULL
mapper.select:

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id, created_at, created_by) SELECT r.id, m.id, #{now}, NULL FROM sys_role r CROSS JOIN sys_menu m WHERE r.id = #{roleId} AND r.code = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND m.type = 'PAGE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu rm WHERE rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.menu_id = m.id )
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{now}, NULL)
